pr_title: scpb: hide embedded index when marshaling to json
pr_body:
This also covers marshaling to yaml.

Fixes #77155

Release justification: Testing only change.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/77169)
😿 this approach is too hacky. It doesn't support extra fields in the message. I wonder if it's worth doing anything? I'm going to put this down for now.

issue_context.title: schemachanger: remove embedded structs from yaml output in tests
issue_context.body:
Embedded structs in schema changer elements show up explicitly and with a separate level of nesting in data-driven test output. It's just noise, remove it.

https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/76776#discussion_r811415998

Jira issue: CRDB-13438
comments: I tried and it's harder than I thought it would be. We'll suffer a layer of indentation for the next while until somebody musters the will to fight this fight.
